# Fonts retained from the pinned upstream source

`SourceHanSerifCN-Regular.ttf`: Copyright © 2017 Adobe Systems Incorporated (http://www.adobe.com/), with Reserved Font Name 'Source'.

`ResourceHanRoundedCN-Regular.ttf`: Copyright © 2018–2019 Cyano Hao. Portions © 2014, 2015, 2018 Adobe (http://www.adobe.com/).

Both font files declare the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1 in their embedded name tables (name IDs 13/14). The complete license is retained at `../../src/engine/webgal/assets/fonts/LICENSE-ResourceHanRounded`.

These are upstream GUI fonts. The interactive host uses system fonts and does not import the upstream `index.scss` or these fonts.
